parsed_review.motivation: The goal is to enable native structured output support for any implementation of 'StructuredOutputConverter', moving away from a restricted dependency on 'BeanOutputConverter' to allow more flexibility in schema generation and output handling.
parsed_review.good_points:
Successfully decouples the structured output logic from 'BeanOutputConverter', allowing custom 'StructuredOutputConverter' implementations.
Introduces 'getJsonSchema()' to the 'StructuredOutputConverter' interface, providing a standard contract for schema retrieval.
Comprehensive unit test coverage for both null and non-null JSON schema scenarios to ensure 'StructuredOutputConverter' flexibility.
parsed_review.bad_points:
Use of mutable 'HashMap' for request context instead of immutable collections potentially introduces side-effect risks.
Use of 'mutate()' on 'ChatClientRequest' risks leaking state modifications to other parts of the application if not carefully managed.
Default implementation of 'getJsonSchema()' in 'StructuredOutputConverter' returns null, which is not actively handled by the consuming 'DefaultChatClient' logic.
Lack of defensive null checking when interacting with the context or converter schema retrieval.
parsed_review.suggestion: Reinstate immutability in context handling by utilizing 'Map.copyOf()' or similar unmodifiable structures. Enhance 'DefaultChatClient' to explicitly check for null values from 'outputConverter.getJsonSchema()' before injecting them into the request context. Move away from direct mutation of 'ChatClientRequest' if possible, or ensure it is fully documented and contained to prevent unintended side effects.
parsed_review.implementation_details:
spring-ai-client-chat/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/chat/client/DefaultChatClient.java: Removed 'instanceof BeanOutputConverter' check in favor of a direct call to 'outputConverter.getJsonSchema()'. Populates 'ChatClientAttributes.STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_SCHEMA' based on generic 'StructuredOutputConverter'.
spring-ai-client-chat/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/chat/client/advisor/ChatModelCallAdvisor.java: Replaced 'Map.copyOf' with 'new HashMap<>()' for request context. Switched to 'chatClientRequest.mutate()' for prompt augmentation, modifying the original object.
spring-ai-model/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/converter/StructuredOutputConverter.java: Introduced '@Nullable default String getJsonSchema()' method.

issues.title: Mutable context side effects
issues.detail: Replacing immutable 'Map.copyOf' with mutable 'new HashMap<>()' allows modification of the context map, which may cause unintended side effects across the client request lifecycle.

issues.title: Potential NullPointerException in DefaultChatClient
issues.detail: The code puts the result of 'outputConverter.getJsonSchema()' into the context map without checking for null, which will throw a NullPointerException if the schema is null.

issues.title: In-place mutation of ChatClientRequest
issues.detail: The use of 'mutate()' modifies the original request instead of creating an isolated version, violating expectations regarding request immutability for observers.

interpretation_references: This PR builds on top of issue #5412.
The PR enables custom StructuredOutputConverter(s) to participate in Native Structured Output.
Our custom converters do not extend BeanOutputConverter.
We previously needed to manually set context attributes instead of passing the converter.
The workaround was derived from understanding how Spring AI handles structured output.
Custom converters can provide a JSON Schema if desired.
We request feedback on this approach.
interpretation_candidates: The changes introduce a default getJsonSchema method to the StructuredOutputConverter interface, allowing all converters to optionally provide a schema.
Consequently, DefaultCallResponseSpec was updated to use this method to retrieve the JSON schema for native structured output support, instead of checking for a specific BeanOutputConverter type.

Additionally, ChatModelCallAdvisor now uses a mutable HashMap for the response context and leverages the ChatClientRequest.mutate() method for better flexibility, while the unit tests were expanded to include native structured output tests using a custom converter.
The original implementation of native structured output support was too restrictive because it only worked if the converter was explicitly a BeanOutputConverter.
By adding getJsonSchema to the StructuredOutputConverter interface, the framework can now support native structured output for any custom converter that provides a schema.

The change in ChatModelCallAdvisor and the response context handling ensures a more robust and flexible approach to managing mutable context and building request augmentations, improving maintainability and interoperability.
